shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures on a flat ground
figures wearing long garments with rendered pleats/folds
procession/orientation of figures in one direction
justification: Both show bearded male figures carved in shallow relief in strict profile, wearing headgear and long pleated garments, gripping vertical staff/spear shafts with both hands, a fairly specific conventional posture. However, A depicts a crowded multi-figure procession with pointed caps, a seated/enthroned figure and architectural elements, whereas B isolates a single large crowned figure with bow and quiver filling the whole field, so composition and scale differ markedly.
